summary: ALM Risk Manager candidate with ~7 years across IRRBB analytics, market risk reporting, and model governance. At Moody's Analytics, holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ($5–25bn per engagement). Runs interest-rate risk analytics under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks (analogous to EVE and NII frameworks); validates fixed income, IR derivatives, and FX pricing and cashflow profiles. Python and SQL practitioner. CFA + dual MSc.

sections.heading: IRRBB & Market Risk Analytics
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs delivered to institutional client portfolios ranging $5–25bn per engagement; independently review curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release.

Oversee interest-rate risk and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks, aligned with IRRBB standards analogous to OSFI B-12 and Basel Committee frameworks — covering the EVE and NII sensitivity dimensions those frameworks require.
Validate pricing and sensitivity outputs across fixed income, linear IR derivatives, and FX — reviewing cashflow profiles, discounting logic, and scenario impacts at portfolio-level ALM aggregates.

sections.heading: Risk Reporting Automation & Data Infrastructure
bullets: Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable, auditable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and version control.

Designed aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into consolidated portfolio-level risk metrics feeding scenario, sensitivity, and ALM reporting — directly analogous to building and maintaining enterprise banking-book position and risk-metric datasets.

Deployed agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, and anomaly detection — reducing development cycle time ~30–40% on comparable modules.

sections.heading: Stress Testing, Liquidity & Stakeholder Communication
bullets: Led design of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios; architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year).
Embedded behavioral cash flow assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays aligned with regulatory liquidity expectations.

Prepared analytical summaries for senior stakeholders on interest-rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities; serve as escalation point for client Heads of Risk on analytical issues.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe analytics platform; advised on asset, liability, and ALM configurations and validated model outputs post-deployment.
Translated investment-team requirements into structured development requests; contributed to the successful migration of all assigned client accounts from a legacy Calypso environment.

roles.title: Senior Consultant – IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients; aligned regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Coordinated across actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and PM teams on milestone delivery, governance documentation, and regulatory-readiness processes.
Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds; analyzed funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet exposures across interest-rate, inflation, and FX risk.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators for stress testing interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base and stressed environments.
Performed cash flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis (IR, inflation, currency) for international clients; modelled actuarial liabilities alongside fixed income, equity, and derivative product types.
Conducted VaR and CVaR portfolio optimization, risk decomposition, and contribution-to-risk analytics on Ortec's GLASS platform; presented findings to investment committees at pension-fund clients.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) – Western University, 2016
